class.name: JarOperationSdf
class.brief_description: Combines two SDFs with a boolean operation (CSG).
class.description: Evaluates two child SDFs and combines their distances with a constructive solid geometry (CSG) operation: union, subtraction, intersection, or their smooth variants. This allows complex volumes to be authored purely as data — for example, subtracting a [JarSphereSdf] from a [JarTerrainSdf] carves a crater into the terrain, while a union merges shapes together. Operation SDFs can be nested (an operand may itself be another [JarOperationSdf]) to build arbitrarily complex shapes from simple primitives. If only one operand is set, its distance is passed through unchanged. If neither is set, empty space is returned.

members.member: The second operand. For subtraction, this is the shape that gets removed from [member sdf_a].

The boolean operation used to combine the operands: [code]0[/code] Union, [code]1[/code] Subtraction ([member sdf_a] minus [member sdf_b]), [code]2[/code] Intersection, [code]3[/code] Smooth Union, [code]4[/code] Smooth Subtraction, [code]5[/code] Smooth Intersection.
Blend radius [code]k[/code] used by the smooth operations. Larger values produce softer, more organic transitions between the two shapes. Ignored by the non-smooth operations.
